description: This file defines various custom exception classes related to AWS IoT SDK operations, including timeout, error, WebSocket, Greengrass discovery, and client errors.

classes.name: acceptTimeoutException
classes.description: Serial exception for accept timeout.

classes.name: connectTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception for MQTT connect timeout, inherits from operationTimeoutException.

classes.name: disconnectTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception for MQTT disconnect timeout, inherits from operationTimeoutException.

classes.name: publishTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception for MQTT publish timeout, inherits from operationTimeoutException.

classes.name: subscribeTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception for MQTT subscribe timeout, inherits from operationTimeoutException.

classes.name: unsubscribeTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception for MQTT unsubscribe timeout, inherits from operationTimeoutException.

classes.name: connectError
classes.description: Represents a connection error, inherits from operationError.

classes.name: disconnectError
classes.description: Represents a disconnection error, inherits from operationError.

classes.name: publishError
classes.description: Represents a publish error, inherits from operationError.

classes.name: publishQueueFullException
classes.description: Indicates the internal publish queue is full.

classes.name: publishQueueDisabledException
classes.description: Indicates offline publish request was dropped due to disabled queueing.

classes.name: subscribeError
classes.description: Represents a subscription error, inherits from operationError.

classes.name: subackError
classes.description: Represents an error with suback, inherits from operationError.

classes.name: subscribeQueueFullException
classes.description: Indicates the internal subscribe queue is full.

classes.name: subscribeQueueDisabledException
classes.description: Indicates offline subscribe request was dropped due to disabled queueing.

classes.name: unsubscribeError
classes.description: Represents an unsubscribe error, inherits from operationError.

classes.name: unsubscribeQueueFullException
classes.description: Indicates the internal unsubscribe queue is full.

classes.name: unsubscribeQueueDisabledException
classes.description: Indicates offline unsubscribe request was dropped due to disabled queueing.

classes.name: wssNoKeyInEnvironmentError
classes.description: WebSocket error when AWS credentials are missing.

classes.name: wssHandShakeError
classes.description: WebSocket handshake error.

classes.name: DiscoveryDataNotFoundException
classes.description: Error when no discovery data is found.

classes.name: DiscoveryTimeoutException
classes.description: Timeout error for discovery requests.

classes.name: DiscoveryInvalidRequestException
classes.description: Invalid discovery request error.

classes.name: DiscoveryUnauthorizedException
classes.description: Unauthorized discovery request error.

classes.name: DiscoveryThrottlingException
classes.description: Throttling error for too many discovery requests.

classes.name: DiscoveryFailure
classes.description: General discovery failure with custom message.

classes.name: ClientError
classes.description: General client error class.
